selection: For full-trial 1 Hz sources choose a 180 s window maximizing additional finite camera priors, ties by total new priors. Existing bounded MP4 refinement sources use all their frames. Exploratory selection, not a held-out test.
prior_sigma_status: Assumed sensitivity weights, not measured position uncertainty
scope: Paired availability and centered RMS, sensor consistency, and old/new fallback constrained mapping. No independent child ground truth.
